mapper.delete: delete from coupon where id = #{id} and received_count = 0
mapper.select: select c.* from coupon c where c.status = 1 and c.start_time <= #{now} and c.end_time >= #{now} and (c.total_count = 0 or c.received_count < c.total_count) and (select count(*) from user_coupon uc where uc.coupon_id = c.id and uc.user_id = #{userId}) < c.limit_per_user order by c.end_time asc, c.id desc
